items.question: How many lakhs of the supreme mantra should one recite, dear?
premises: One recites it that many lakhs.
The instruction is addressed to the dear one.
items.inference: The recitation count is specified as that many lakhs.
uncertainties: Exact internal parsing of tattvalakṣaṃ remains uncertain.
items.plain_english: Dear one, recite the supreme śrī-prāsāda mantra that many lakhs of times.
